text:
incidents-bot: PAGER — model-serving-prod: sudden spike in 5xx + decode failures for model=redwood-alpha. Alert: 86% increase in 'detokenize' exceptions. Link: <https://redwood/alerts/2755551234>

anya-release: I just pushed a staged rollout -> redwood-alpha:v2.1.0, 10% traffic. Deploy used tokenizer 'tokenizer_v4' but weights bundle referenced looks like w-2026-03-15 (older). Could be a mismatch in artifacts.

ava-runtime: Confirming weird outputs. Canary logs include token ids > vocab_size and outputs like "��\u0002�". Detokenizer failing with KeyError on id=50231.

jamal-oncall: Acknowledged. Jamal taking pager. @anya-release @ava-runtime please paste the deploy command and commit.

anya-release: deploy command: `./deploy.sh --tag redwood-alpha:v2.1.0 --weights-bundle w-2026-03-15 --tokenizer tokenizer_v4` commit: a1b2c3d (CI 54321).

leo-sre: That looks like config drift — tokenizer from 'latest' but weights pinned to a stable bundle. CI should have prevented that. Locking down now.

marco-ops: Flipping emergency kill-switch (feature flag) to route traffic back to stable: `model.alpha.use_latest -> false`.

marco-ops: command:
```
curl -XPOST "https://flags.redwood/api/toggle" -d '{"flag":"model.alpha.use_latest","value":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer **REDACTED**"
```

marco-ops: Flag flipped. Traffic routed to redwood-alpha:v2.0.9. Watching error rate.

priya-cs: Support: 3 customer tickets with gibberish outputs: #8764 #8765 #8766. Notified AEs and account owners.

ava-runtime: Error rate on canary dropped from 18% -> 2% after flag flip, but logs show some nodes still trying to load tokenizer_v4 (artifact-syncer probably).

anya-release: Found root cause: release pipeline pulled tokenizer from 'latest' s3 prefix. A recent artifact naming change made tokenizer_v4 appear compatible; deploy job didn't validate tokenizer<->weights hash pair.

jamal-oncall: Mitigation plan: 1) keep flag off 2) pause artifact-syncer for model-alpha 3) drain any nodes that pulled tokenizer_v4 and restart with tokenizer_v3 4) postmortem + CI hash validation.

ava-runtime: Running drain: `./nodectl drain --selector model=redwood-alpha --filter tokenizer=tokenizer_v4`

ava-runtime: command output:
```
Draining 4 nodes...
Evicted 4 pods
Restarting with tokenizer=tokenizer_v3
```

leo-sre: Drains complete. Canary error rate back to baseline. No customer-facing errors observed on stable traffic.

jamal-oncall: Handoff -> @sophia-oncall for next shift. Sophia, please keep `model.alpha.use_latest` false and ensure artifact-syncer stays disabled. Also run `sha256sum` checks for tokenizer/weights on all nodes.

sophia-oncall: Ack, taking over. Will run periodic artifact consistency checks for 6 hours and coordinate RCA.

priya-cs: Sent initial customer note: short apology + mitigation steps + offer to follow up with RCA. Will escalate refunds if needed.

anya-release: Patching deploy pipeline: will lock tokenizer hash in release manifest and add CI gate to validate tokenizer<->weights mapping. Opening PR now.

incidents-bot: RESOLVED (mitigated) — traffic reverted to stable, kill-switch active, bad nodes drained. Severity lowered to Sev2. Incident record: <https://redwood/incidents/2755551234>

sophia-oncall: Closing handoff notes: actions logged, logs archived to /incidents/2755551234/. Will draft full RCA and share with the team.

priya-cs: Thanks everyone — will coordinate external comms after RCA review.
